title: OmniExtract Universal Content & Transcript Extractor Input

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more URLs to extract (X/Twitter tweets & long-form Articles, Douyin, TikTok, YouTube, Bilibili, GitHub, or any web article).

include_transcript.title: Include Video Subtitles / Transcript
include_transcript.description: Automatically extract clean plain-text transcript and timestamped segments for YouTube/Bilibili/TikTok videos.

use_cache.title: Enable 24h Fast Cache
use_cache.description: Return cached extraction results instantaneously if the same URL was extracted within 24 hours.
